Title: Generally Available: Firmware analysis enabled by Azure Arc

Body.Content:
Firmware analysis enabled by Azure Arc is now generally available. Firmware analysis brings deep visibility into the software that powers IoT/OT and network devices—systems that often operate as “black boxes” with limited insight into their security posture. Users upload a device firmware image and receive a detailed report after an automated security analysis.
Learn more.
